fields.description: Path to an agent definition markdown file with YAML frontmatter.
Built-in or discovered agent definition name. Also GROK_AGENT and --agent-profile.
Global system-prompt identity; per-model override wins.
Remote announcement payloads consumed at load. Not a user-authored table.
Alias of [grok_com_config]; every grok_com_config. key also works as auth..

External auth binary; stdout is the token. With endpoints.models_base_url or models_list_url set, that endpoint's list decides which models are offered. Also GROK_AUTH_PROVIDER_COMMAND; also valid as grok_com_config.auth_provider_command.
Login button label for an external auth provider. Also GROK_AUTH_PROVIDER_LABEL; also valid as grok_com_config.auth_provider_label.
Token TTL in seconds for providers that return a bare token. Also GROK_AUTH_TOKEN_TTL; also valid as grok_com_config.auth_token_ttl.
Refuse API-key auth so only the deployment IdP can log in. Also GROK_DISABLE_API_KEY_AUTH; also valid as grok_com_config.disable_api_key_auth.
Require login to this team UUID, or any of an array; empty array fails closed. Also GROK_FORCE_LOGIN_TEAM_ID; also valid as grok_com_config.force_login_team_uuid.
Websocket origin for grok.com. Also GROK_WS_ORIGIN; also valid as grok_com_config.grok_ws_origin.
Relay websocket URL. Also GROK_WS_URL; also valid as grok_com_config.grok_ws_url.
OAuth2 provider used when enterprise OIDC is unset; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.
OAuth2 client id. Also GROK_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.client_id.
OAuth2 issuer URL. Also GROK_OAUTH2_ISSUER; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.issuer.
Required principal id when principal_type is set. Also GROK_OAUTH2_PRINCIPAL_ID; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.principal_id.
Token principal type, such as Team. Also GROK_OAUTH2_PRINCIPAL_TYPE; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.principal_type.
Referrer for OAuth usage attribution. Also GROK_OAUTH2_REFERRER; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.referrer.
OAuth2 scopes. Also GROK_OAUTH2_SCOPES; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.scopes.
Customer OIDC identity-provider settings; also valid as grok_com_config.oidc.
Optional OIDC audience. Also GROK_OIDC_AUDIENCE; also valid as grok_com_config.oidc.audience.
OIDC client id. Also GROK_OIDC_CLIENT_ID; also valid as grok_com_config.oidc.client_id.
OIDC issuer URL. Also GROK_OIDC_ISSUER; also valid as grok_com_config.oidc.issuer.
OIDC scopes. Also GROK_OIDC_SCOPES; also valid as grok_com_config.oidc.scopes.
Pin automatic auth to one method with no fallthrough; also valid as grok_com_config.preferred_method.
Header name that carries the CLI auth token; default xai-grok-cli; also valid as grok_com_config.token_header.
Named credential helper used by [model.<id>] auth_provider.
Enable Auto permission mode.
Named campaign patches applied below requirements. The deployment publishes these.
Check for CLI updates on launch. Also GROK_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER to suppress.

Optional private artifact prefix for the internal installer. Only an allowlisted prefix is accepted. The updater attaches a gcloud auth print-access-token bearer only to URLs under that prefix, so run gcloud auth login first. Set update_base = "" and run grok update --stable to return to the public channel.
Which installer last set up this CLI, used to pick the update path.
Highest CLI version that still runs without a hard block. Also GROK_MAXIMUM_VERSION.
Lowest CLI version that still runs without a hard block. Also GROK_MINIMUM_VERSION.
npm registry used by the auto-updater.
Hard maximum CLI version. Also GROK_REQUIRED_MAXIMUM_VERSION.
Hard minimum CLI version. Also GROK_REQUIRED_MINIMUM_VERSION.
Group sessions by repo in the picker and CLI listings.
Participate in the cross-process session registry.
Startup tips.
Use the leader process for config reload and MCP watches.

Creation-mode when set to linked, standalone, or git. The spellings grove, grove-fuse, grove-nfs, nfs, and copy also feed the session / -w Grove gate (same as cli.grove_worktree); they are not creation-mode values.
Scan CLAUDE.md. Also GROK_CLAUDE_AGENTS_ENABLED.
Scan Claude hooks. Also GROK_CLAUDE_HOOKS_ENABLED.
Scan Claude MCP config. Also GROK_CLAUDE_MCPS_ENABLED.
Scan Claude rules. Also GROK_CLAUDE_RULES_ENABLED.
Scan Claude skills. Also GROK_CLAUDE_SKILLS_ENABLED.
Scan Codex hooks when present.
Scan Codex skills directories when present.
Scan agent definitions from Cursor compat sources. Also GROK_CURSOR_AGENTS_ENABLED.
Scan Cursor hooks. Also GROK_CURSOR_HOOKS_ENABLED.
Scan Cursor mcp.json. Also GROK_CURSOR_MCPS_ENABLED.
Scan .cursor/rules/. Also GROK_CURSOR_RULES_ENABLED.
Scan Cursor skills directories. Also GROK_CURSOR_SKILLS_ENABLED.
Register this leader as a Cursor private worker at startup; default false.
Worker display name shown in Cursor; default is the machine hostname.
Absolute paths of the repository directories offered to Cursor Cloud Agents; the first is the registered working directory.
Maximum concurrently claimed Cloud Agents per door (an idle claim frees its slot), beyond which a new agent fails rather than queues; unset means no cap.
Also register the any-repo door, which clones whatever repository a Cloud Agent brings. Opt-in, default off.
Computer Hub base URL used to obtain the Cursor session; default is derived from the leader's hub URL.
Rewrite worktree and snapshot paths in shell output back to the registered directory; default true.
Show the agent dashboard.
How dashboard rows group.
Start sessions in auto permission mode when no per-session override is set.
Write a panic report under $GROK_HOME/crash/. Also GROK_CRASH_HANDLER.
Drop the web_search tool for this process. Also --disable-web-search.
MCP server names to skip without deleting their [mcp_servers] blocks.
Per-server MCP tool deny lists keyed by server name.
Resample confident tool-call loops; set false to disable.
Session-service API base URL.
Management key for enterprise deployments. Also GROK_DEPLOYMENT_KEY.
Where feedback submissions go. Also GROK_FEEDBACK_BASE_URL.
Override managed config endpoint. Also GROK_MANAGED_CONFIG_URL.
Custom inference base URL. With auth_provider_command set, {models_base_url}/models decides which models are offered. Also GROK_MODELS_BASE_URL.
Override model-list URL. With auth_provider_command set, this list decides which models are offered. Also GROK_MODELS_LIST_URL. Alias models_endpoint.
Direct gs:// or s3:// bucket for traces; bypasses the proxy. Also GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_BUCKET.
Inline GCS service-account JSON or AWS credentials for that bucket; wins over trace_upload_credentials_file and has no environment variable.
Path to a GCS service-account JSON or AWS credentials file for that bucket. Also GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_CREDENTIALS_FILE.
Custom S3-compatible endpoint for s3:// bucket uploads. Also GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_ENDPOINT_URL.
AWS region for s3:// bucket uploads; default us-east-1. Also GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_REGION.
Proxy destination for traces when no direct bucket is set. Also GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_URL.
Public xAI API base. Also GROK_XAI_API_BASE_URL.
Enable or disable active_agent_messages. Default false. Also GROK_ACTIVE_AGENT_MESSAGES.
Enable or disable ask_user_question. Default true. Also GROK_ASK_USER_QUESTION.
Enable or disable auto_wake. Default true. Also GROK_AUTO_WAKE.
Enable or disable backend_tools. Default true. Also GROK_BACKEND_SEARCH.
Enable remote campaign patches. GROK_CAMPAIGNS=0 still disables even when requirements set this true.
Enable or disable cancel_rewind. Default true. Also GROK_CANCEL_REWIND.
Codebase graph indexing; true indexes git repos, or pass include/exclude globs.
Verbatim detail level for segments compaction. Also GROK_COMPACTION_DETAIL.
Compaction strategy. Also GROK_COMPACTION_MODE.
Tool-choice hint used during compaction.
Enable or disable compaction_verbatim_input. Default true. Also GROK_COMPACTION_VERBATIM_INPUT.
Enable or disable dock. Default false. Also GROK_DOCK.
Enable or disable feedback. Default true. Also GROK_FEEDBACK_ENABLED.
Show a trace-upload consent question after /feedback. Default false. Also GROK_FEEDBACK_TRACE_CARD.
Hand local sessions' file systems to a file accelerator when the build installs one. Default false. Also GROK_FILE_ACCELERATION.
Imagine model id for image_edit.
Enable image_gen / /imagine.
Imagine model id for image_gen. Empty defers to the remotely configured default.
Enable or disable lsp_tools. Default false. Also GROK_LSP_TOOLS.
Fetch managed_config.toml and requirements.toml from the deployment.
Auto-restart stdio MCP servers after transport failure. Also GROK_MCP_AUTO_RESTART.
Poll MCP transports and push server_status updates. Emergency kill switch when false.
Pager subscribes to MCP server_status push. Process env GROK_MCP_PUSH_SERVER_STATUS wins at launch.
Watch <cwd>/ and <cwd>/.grok/ for project MCP config edits. Name is a misnomer; watches are non-recursive.
Show a blocking warning when Grok starts outside a Git repository.
Remember the last permission mode across sessions. Read from user config.toml only.
Pin remote model-catalog and asset fetch. Managed wins over the user file when both set.
Enable or disable session_recap. Default true. Also GROK_SESSION_RECAP.
Enable or disable session_search. Default true. Also GROK_SESSION_SEARCH.

Hide the subagent model argument when every model you can pick is an xAI model, so subagents inherit the parent's model. Default false. Also GROK_SUBAGENT_MODEL_INHERITANCE. Read when a session starts; changing it requires a restart.
Enable or disable subagent_worktree_snapshot. Default false. Also GROK_SUBAGENT_WORKTREE_SNAPSHOT.
Allow the agent to ask permission for tool executions.
Product telemetry mode. Enterprise default is off.
Reveal the terminal-native terminal color theme during its rollout. Default false. Also GROK_TERMINAL_THEME.
Early-session auto-title refresh. Pin this in requirements to beat GROK_TITLE_REFRESH.
Enable or disable turn_summary. Default true. Also GROK_TURN_SUMMARY.
Enable or disable two_pass_compaction. Default true. Also GROK_TWO_PASS_COMPACTION.
Enable video tools / /imagine-video.
Enable or disable voice_mode. Default true. Also GROK_VOICE_MODE.
Enable or disable web_fetch. Default false. Also GROK_WEB_FETCH.
Enable or disable write_file. Default true. Also GROK_WRITE_FILE.
Advertise ZDR-incompatible tools when the team is on Zero Data Retention. Also GROK_ZDR_ACCESS_ENABLED.
Shell command that prints name and email JSON for feedback submissions.
Sources for the feedback author email (git_email or a literal).
Sources for the feedback author name (os_user or a literal).
Route override passed unparsed to the installed file accelerator; empty is unset. Also GROK_FILE_ACCELERATION_ROUTES.
Enable /goal.
Grok.com websocket and OAuth/OIDC settings. [auth] is an alias.
External auth binary; stdout is the token. With endpoints.models_base_url or models_list_url set, that endpoint's list decides which models are offered. Also GROK_AUTH_PROVIDER_COMMAND.
Login button label for an external auth provider. Also GROK_AUTH_PROVIDER_LABEL.
Token TTL in seconds for providers that return a bare token. Also GROK_AUTH_TOKEN_TTL.
Refuse API-key auth so only the deployment IdP can log in. Also GROK_DISABLE_API_KEY_AUTH.
Require login to this team UUID, or any of an array; empty array fails closed. Also GROK_FORCE_LOGIN_TEAM_ID.
Websocket origin for grok.com. Also GROK_WS_ORIGIN.
Relay websocket URL. Also GROK_WS_URL.
OAuth2 provider used when enterprise OIDC is unset.
OAuth2 client id. Also GROK_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID.
OAuth2 issuer URL. Also GROK_OAUTH2_ISSUER.
Required principal id when principal_type is set. Also GROK_OAUTH2_PRINCIPAL_ID.
Token principal type, such as Team. Also GROK_OAUTH2_PRINCIPAL_TYPE.
Referrer for OAuth usage attribution. Also GROK_OAUTH2_REFERRER.
OAuth2 scopes. Also GROK_OAUTH2_SCOPES.
Customer OIDC identity-provider settings.
Optional OIDC audience. Also GROK_OIDC_AUDIENCE.
OIDC client id. Also GROK_OIDC_CLIENT_ID.
OIDC issuer URL. Also GROK_OIDC_ISSUER.
OIDC scopes. Also GROK_OIDC_SCOPES.
Pin automatic auth to one method with no fallthrough.
Header name that carries the CLI auth token; default xai-grok-cli.

Wait for turn-end trace uploads before returning the prompt response. Off by default; one-shot headless runs instead drain pending turn-end uploads at exit within a mandatory minimum budget (about 150s: the parse window plus one upload attempt) that upload_flush_timeout_secs, when larger, extends.
Kill switch for per-turn workspace snapshots.
Whether /fork offers a worktree.
Whether /new offers a worktree.
Matcher groups for a lifecycle event such as PreToolUse or Stop. See Hooks.
Command to run for this hook. $VAR is not expanded at load.
Hook handler type. Command hooks are supported.
Tool-name matcher for this hook group.
Inject a mid-turn reminder to reason briefly after a model call with long hidden reasoning. Default false. Also GROK_LONG_REASONING_REMINDER (a bool word, or a JSON object in this table's shape).
Reasoning tokens in one model call that count as long. Default 1000, clamped to 100–200000. Also tokens in the GROK_LONG_REASONING_REMINDER JSON object.
Model calls to wait after the long call before the reminder. Default 1, clamped to 0–10. Also delay in the GROK_LONG_REASONING_REMINDER JSON object.
Fetch managed MCP configs at startup. Also GROK_MANAGED_MCPS_ENABLED.
Expose managed MCP gateway tools. Also GROK_MANAGED_MCP_GATEWAY_TOOLS_ENABLED.
[[marketplace.sources]] plugin marketplace repos.
Tighten-only: remote plugin installs and updates must pin a full commit sha. Also GROK_MARKETPLACE_REQUIRE_SHA. Neither this key nor the env var can turn the gate back off.
Cap MCP tool output size in bytes. Project files may set this.
[mcp_servers.<name>] args on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] bearer_token_env_var on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] bearer_token_file on an HTTP MCP server: absolute or ~/ path to a bearer token, re-read on every request.
[mcp_servers.<name>] command on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] cwd on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] enabled on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] env on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] expose_image_base64 on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] headers on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] oauth on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] oauth_client_id on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] oauth_client_secret_env_var on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] oauth_scopes on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] setup on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] startup_timeout_sec on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] tool_timeout_sec on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] tool_timeouts on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] type on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
[mcp_servers.<name>] url on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.
Legacy memory switch. Also GROK_MEMORY; superseded when the v2 gate is enabled.
Primary memory-v2 switch. When true, v2 takes precedence over legacy memory.enabled. When false or absent, legacy enablement is resolved normally. Default: false.

Shows memory-v2 capture lifecycle messages in the UI for debugging. Successful captures are expandable and include generated content plus links to committed observation files. Telemetry and debug logs are always recorded. Default: false.
Enables memory-v2 extraction and observation capture. Default: true.
Enables event-driven memory-v2 Dream. Default: true.
Enables explicitly requested memory-v2 Dream. Default: true.
Runs active memory-v2 Dream as batch Dream, which folds notes into topics in batches with the full topic catalog; a local value wins over remote memory_v2.batch_dream_enabled, then defaults to false.
Caps one batch Dream run in seconds, default 1800, clamped to 60–3600; unfinished notes stay in the inbox. A local value wins over remote memory_v2.batch_dream_max_run_secs.
Caps model calls per batch Dream batch, default 6, clamped to 2–16. A local value wins over remote memory_v2.batch_dream_max_calls_per_batch.
Caps note bytes in one batch Dream batch, default 98304, clamped to 16384–262144. A local value wins over remote memory_v2.batch_dream_max_batch_note_bytes.

Injects a titles-only memory index into the system prompt (no topic descriptions, no pending observations) so more topics fit the 8 KiB budget; titled entries are ordered by how often the agent has read each topic, and the on-disk MEMORY.md is rendered the same way. A local value wins over the remote memory_v2.compact_index_enabled. Default: false.
Enables all memory-v2 file mutation; false fails closed before scaffold creation. Default: true.
Retains archived memory-v2 observation files for this many days. Default: 30.
Retains terminal memory-v2 capture-job metadata for this many days. Default: 14.
Per-model override or BYOK definition. Prefer env_key over inline api_key.
Agent definition type associated with this model.
Wire protocol for this model.
Alternate API base used with XAI_API_KEY resolution.
Inline API key. Prefer env_key. Not a secret to put in a shared repo.
Name of a [auth_provider.<name>] helper that mints this model's bearer token.
Per-model auto-compact threshold (0-100).
Provider endpoint base URL.
Token threshold that triggers compaction for this model.
How compaction leftover context is sent. Alias send_compactions_remaining.
Context window tokens; drives auto-compact timing.
Optional description shown in the picker.
HTTP headers populated from environment variables when set.
Environment variable name(s) holding the provider API key.
Per-request headers for this model.
Hide this model from the picker. Still usable via -m.
Idle timeout for streaming inference on this model.
Per-model max completion tokens.
Provider request-body cap that inline images are evicted to stay under. Unset inherits the [model_providers.<id>] value, then the api_backend default: 30 MB for messages, 50 MiB otherwise.
Inference retries for this model.
Model id sent to the API.
Family id used for compaction and capability grouping.
Named [model_providers.<name>] provider id for this model.

Directory containing the model endpoint's mTLS identity as client.crt and client.key, or tls.crt and tls.key; configuration is rejected unless the same model has one HTTPS base_url and no api_base_url, and requests do not follow redirects.
Label shown in the model picker.
Extra query parameters on this model's requests.
Total-attempt ceiling for rate-limited requests, capped by the resolved max_retries; when configured, it disables the separate subagent 429 wait loop.
Deprecated per-model effort; prefer reasoning_efforts.
Allowed reasoning-effort values for this model. When omitted, the menu comes from the endpoint's /v1/models row (reasoning_efforts, or capabilities.reasoning_effort when that is absent).
Responses API reasoning.summary for this model; default concise. none omits the field for endpoints that reject it (e.g. AWS Bedrock Mantle).
Show the provider model fingerprint in the UI when present.
Per-model tool-call streaming request shape.
Maximum subagent 429 wait-loop attempts when rate_limit_retry_threshold is unset; default 8, maximum 32, and 0 disables the wait loop.
Whether this catalog entry is offered as a public API model.
Whether the endpoint supports Grok-hosted server-side search tools.
Deprecated; prefer reasoning_efforts. An explicit false keeps the model out of any menu it would otherwise inherit from the endpoint or from a same-model catalog entry.
Per-model system-prompt identity label.
Per-model sampling temperature.
Per-model top_p.
Use the concise tool-description pack for this model.
Named custom model provider definition.
Fallback agent_type for models without a per-model override.
Glob allowlist for the model picker, default, and -m, ignored outside requirements.toml when auth_provider_command and a custom models endpoint are set. Empty means no restriction.
Model used for new sessions. Also GROK_DEFAULT_MODEL, --model, -m.
Default reasoning effort for the default model when the model supports it.
Remove these model IDs from the catalog. Wins over hidden_models.
Request headers applied to every model; per-model keys win.
Hide these model IDs from the picker; -m can still select them.
Vision model used to transcribe user-supplied images.
Global idle timeout for streaming inference when a model leaves it unset.
Global max completion tokens default when a model leaves it unset.
Global inference retry default when a model leaves it unset.
Model pin for next-prompt ghost text. Unset falls through remote, then the session model.
Global total-attempt ceiling for rate-limited requests when a model leaves it unset, capped by the resolved max_retries; when configured, it disables the separate subagent 429 wait loop.
Model used for session titles and summaries.
Global tool-call streaming request shape; some BYOK endpoints need false.
Global default for subagent 429 wait-loop attempts when rate_limit_retry_threshold is unset; default 8, maximum 32, and 0 disables the wait loop.
Global sampling temperature default when a model leaves it unset.
Global top_p default when a model leaves it unset.
Model used by the client web_search tool. Also GROK_WEB_SEARCH_MODEL.
Enrich path-not-found errors with CWD reminders and similar-name suggestions.
More rule directories (absolute or ~/…; each contains *.md), loaded after the home rules.
Records /import-claude skill directories that skill injection ignores in favor of [skills] paths.
Compact allow rules such as Bash(git *). Deny beats ask beats allow. Project files may set this.
Compact ask rules. Project files may set this.
Compact deny rules. Project files may set this.
Verbose action/tool/pattern object rules. Project files may set this.
Plugin IDs to discover but not load. Project files may set this.
Plugin IDs to enable; needed for project plugins that default off.
Additional plugin directories. Project files may set this when the folder is trusted.
RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the local privacy banner was dismissed. The pager reads user config.toml only.
Enable session relay sync.
Skip bash permission prompts when a sandbox profile is active. Also GROK_SANDBOX_AUTO_ALLOW_BASH.
Filesystem sandbox profile. Also --sandbox and GROK_SANDBOX.
Auto-compact when context usage reaches this percent (0–100).
Inject .envrc variables into bash.
Env names to drop from bash. Overlay-allowlisted.
Skip the built-in env denylist. Overlay-allowlisted.
If set, bash inherits only these env names. Overlay-allowlisted.
Which parent env names bash inherits. Overlay-allowlisted; cannot inject values.
Inject env values into bash. Not overlay-allowlisted.
Skill names to discover but not activate.
Additional skill directories.
Days a session may stay idle before its folder is deleted; media and terminal logs older than this are pruned from live sessions; unset or 0 disables cleanup.
Subagent / task tool master switch, default true even when other subagents.* keys are set. Also GROK_SUBAGENTS or --no-subagents.
What to do when the concurrent subagent cap is hit.
Max concurrent subagents.
Max nested subagent depth (clamped ≥1).
Per-subagent model id override.
Enable or disable an individual subagent type. Omitted agents default on.
External OTEL master switch. Also GROK_EXTERNAL_OTEL.
External OTEL metrics exporter. Also OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER.
External OTEL logs exporter. Also OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER.
External OTLP base endpoint. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT. Pin strips developer env and unlisted user/managed file siblings except listed.
Logs-signal OTLP endpoint (verbatim). Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT.
Metrics-signal OTLP endpoint (verbatim). Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT.
External OTLP transport. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL. Pin strips per-signal protocol env and unlisted file siblings except listed.
Logs-signal OTLP protocol. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_PROTOCOL.
Metrics-signal OTLP protocol. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_PROTOCOL.
Export timeout in milliseconds. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT.
Metric export interval in milliseconds. Also OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL.
PEM path of extra CA certs for the collector. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CERTIFICATE. CA pin does not strip endpoints.
Logs-signal CA PEM path. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_CERTIFICATE.
Metrics-signal CA PEM path. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_CERTIFICATE.
PEM path of the mTLS client certificate. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE. Pin strips credential copies, developer endpoints, and unlisted file siblings.
PEM path of the mTLS client key. Tokens never live in this file. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CLIENT_KEY.
Logs-signal mTLS client cert PEM path. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE.
Logs-signal mTLS client key PEM path. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_CLIENT_KEY.
Metrics-signal mTLS client cert PEM path. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE.
Metrics-signal mTLS client key PEM path. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_CLIENT_KEY.
Attach session.id to metrics. Also OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_SESSION_ID.
Content gate for prompt text on grok_code.user_prompt. Also OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS. Pinning any content gate without listing a sibling defaults the omitted sibling off.
Metadata gate for tool-arg preview, paths, and verbatim names. Recommended on for SIEM join. Also OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS. Does not include full bodies.

Content gate for grok_code.assistant_response text. Unset follows otel_log_user_prompts unless a sibling gate is pinned in requirements. Env-only OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1 must set this to 0 (or pin it false) for a prompts-only stream. Also OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES.
Body gate for tool_input, tool_output, full_command, and error_message. Independent of details; default off. CONTENT-only loses verbatim MCP names and paths. Also OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT.
Upload session traces. Requirements pin beats user config.
Restrict tools that need xAI-hosted output under ZDR. Also GROK_DISABLE_ZDR_INCOMPATIBLE_TOOLS.
Cap parallel image_gen/image_edit calls in one model step. Also GROK_MAX_PARALLEL_IMAGE_GEN_CALLS.
Cap parallel video_gen calls in one model step. Also GROK_MAX_PARALLEL_VIDEO_GEN_CALLS.
When true, search and read tools skip gitignored files. Also GROK_RESPECT_GITIGNORE.
Team S3 bucket for ZDR video output. See ZDR Video Storage.
Timeout for the ask_user_question tool.
Background the command when the foreground timeout fires.
Capture the user's login shell environment for bash. Overlay-allowlisted.
Cap on model-requested foreground timeouts.
Max captured bash output in bytes.
Foreground bash command timeout in seconds.
File edit tool scheme.
Domain allowlist override for web_fetch.
Egress proxy URL for web_fetch. Also GROK_WEB_FETCH_PROXY.
Domain allowlist for client web_search. Overlay-allowlisted.
Domain denylist for client web_search. Overlay-allowlisted.
Deprecated; use ui.permission_mode.
Theme when theme = auto and the OS is dark.
Theme when theme = auto and the OS is light.
What to do with running subagents when cancelling a parent turn.
Show edits as one-line +N/-M summaries. Also GROK_COLLAPSED_EDIT_BLOCKS.
Merge consecutive plain follow-ups into one turn.
Denser message padding. Also /compact-mode.
Ask before rewinding conversation history.
The dashboard preview and reply panel appear by default (Appearance in /settings).
Clipboard image paste tip when the model accepts images.
Suggest plan mode (Shift+Tab) for planning-style prompts.
After queuing a mid-turn follow-up, Enter on an empty prompt sends now.
Suggest /compact-mode on short terminals.
Recommend grok wrap when SSH lacks a clipboard sink.
Ctrl+Z restores a wiped prompt draft tip.
After double-click with fold/nav selection, point at Word select in settings.
Force blinking (true) or steady (false) block cursor. Unset inherits the terminal.
Preselected approval row on the first prompt of a session. Also GROK_DEFAULT_SELECTED_PERMISSION.
Match stream/scroll cadence to display refresh rate. Also GROK_DISPLAY_REFRESH_AUTO_CADENCE.
Mid-turn follow-up routing.
Model for the secondary agent when forking. Defaults to the main default model.
Fold consecutive read/search/list tool rows. Also GROK_GROUP_TOOL_VERBS.
File-change hunk tracking. Also GROK_HUNK_TRACKER and --hunk-tracker-mode.
Reverse vertical scroll direction. Also GROK_INVERT_SCROLL.
In-app selection: brief flash, hold, or double-click word select.
Column width for the thoughts panel (40–500).
Ctrl+R in scrollback toggles terminal mouse capture. Also GROK_MOUSE_REPORTING_TOGGLE.
Snap the sent prompt to the top of the viewport.
Default tool-permission behavior. Enterprise locks use requirements.toml.
Next-prompt ghost text after each turn. Also GROK_PROMPT_SUGGESTIONS; a remote kill-switch can disable it fleet-wide.
Visible-output tokens for the suggestion call; clamped to 16–256, default 64, with a separate reserve for reasoning. Remote-overridable.
Sampling temperature for the suggestion call (default 0.2). Remote-overridable.
Reasoning effort for the suggestion call; default and none disable reasoning, while other values use a supported model effort. Remote-overridable.
Show per-tool Always allow options. Also GROK_REMEMBER_TOOL_APPROVALS.
How mermaid fences render: clickable open row or raw source.
Default render mode for plain grok. Restart required.
Lines per scroll tick (1–10). Also GROK_SCROLL_LINES.
Scroll input classification. Also GROK_SCROLL_MODE.
Mouse/trackpad scroll speed multiplier (1–100). Also GROK_SCROLL_SPEED.
Show thinking/reasoning blocks while streaming. Also GROK_SHOW_THINKING_BLOCKS.
Per-turn tick rail instead of the scrollbar.
Clock time next to messages. Also /timestamps.
Readline prompt editing when true; experimental vim prompt keys when false.
Script for a command status line. Campaigns strip this path; a requirements layer still merges it.
Optional status-line row above the shortcuts bar. Off by default. See the status-line user guide.
Color theme name, or auto/system to follow the OS. Also /theme and GROK_THEME.
Legacy alias for ui.theme.
Vim keys in the scrollback, not the prompt. Also /vim-mode.
Hold-to-talk or press-to-toggle voice capture.
Enable Ctrl+Space / F8 for voice dictation. /voice still works when false.
Speech-to-text language code or auto. Overrides [voice].language for the session.
Always-approve tool calls. Requirements can pin false and block --yolo.
Per-CLI-version config patches applied before merge. See [[version_overrides]].
HTTPS API root for speech-to-text. Unset inherits [endpoints].xai_api_base_url.
Preferred STT language catalog code or auto.
STT capture rate in Hz.
Enable workflows.
Automatic worktree garbage collection policy.
